title: cephaelis pobeguinii
intro: Cephaelis pobeguinii, commonly known as Pobeguin's Ipecacuanha, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its use in treating digestive issues and its emetic properties. The health benefits of Cephaelis pobeguinii include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and aid in the expulsion of stomach contents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting emesis and stimulating digestion.
